rules.v: The general labor statute applies in full
rules.vi: UU ketenagakerjaan umum berlaku penuh
rules.n: The Employment Ordinance applies in full.

rules.v: A separate floor applies that is lower than, or not linked to, the national minimum
rules.vi: Berlaku batas upah terpisah yang lebih rendah atau tidak terkait upah minimum nasional
rules.n: The statutory minimum wage does not apply to domestic workers who live in the household free of charge, a class wider than foreign helpers. A Minimum Allowable Wage set by government applies instead: HK$5,100 for contracts from 30 Sep 2025 and HK$5,220 for contracts signed on or after 3 Oct 2026, plus food or a food allowance.
rules.s: Minimum Wage Ordinance (Cap. 608) s. 7(3); HKSAR press releases, 29 Sep 2025 and 2 Oct 2026

rules.v: Only minimum rest periods apply, or limits apply with sector exclusions
rules.vi: Hanya waktu istirahat minimum, atau batas berlaku dengan pengecualian sektor
rules.n: No statutory limit on hours (none exists for any worker in Hong Kong); a weekly rest day and statutory holidays apply.
rules.s: Employment Ordinance Parts IV and VIII

rules.v: May change only on listed grounds, a limited number of times or with official approval
rules.vi: Hanya boleh pindah atas alasan tertentu, terbatas jumlahnya atau dengan persetujuan resmi
rules.n: May change employer, but must normally leave Hong Kong within two weeks of the contract ending and apply from abroad; frequent changes are refused as 'job-hopping'.
rules.s: Immigration Department, Foreign Domestic Helpers page and guidance (official guidance)

rules.v: May form and join unions on equal terms
rules.vi: Boleh membentuk dan bergabung dengan serikat secara setara
rules.n: May form and join unions under the Trade Unions Ordinance.

rules.v: Fees charged to the worker are capped or regulated
rules.vi: Biaya bagi pekerja dibatasi atau diatur
rules.n: Agencies may charge job-seekers no more than 10% of the first month's wage.
rules.s: Employment Agency Regulations (Cap. 57A) reg. 10(2), Second Schedule Part II

rules.v: Only employer-bought private or accident insurance is required
rules.vi: Hanya asuransi swasta atau kecelakaan yang dibeli majikan
rules.n: Employees' compensation insurance is compulsory and the employer must provide free medical treatment; helpers are exempt from the Mandatory Provident Fund.
rules.s: Employees' Compensation Ordinance; Standard Employment Contract (ID 407) cl. 9(a)

rules.v: A dedicated public channel for migrant workers in their languages
rules.vi: Saluran publik khusus pekerja migran dalam bahasa mereka
rules.n: Labour Department hotline and a dedicated portal for helpers in 12 languages.

rules.fi: Jalur ke izin tinggal jangka panjang
rules.v: No route: fixed maximum stay, or time does not count
rules.vi: Tidak ada jalur: masa tinggal maksimum tetap, atau masa tinggal tidak dihitung
rules.n: Time as a helper does not count as ordinary residence for permanent residence (Immigration Ordinance s. 2(4)(a)(vi)); upheld by the Court of Final Appeal in Vallejos (2013).
rules.s: Immigration Ordinance (Cap. 115); Vallejos v Commissioner of Registration, FACV 19/2012 (2013)

rules.v: Barred
rules.vi: Dilarang
rules.n: Helpers may not bring dependants.

rules.gi: Hong Kong SAR · pekerja rumah tangga

rules.gi: Hong Kong SAR · pekerja rumah tangga

rules.gi: Hong Kong SAR · pekerja rumah tangga

rules.vi: Minimal 24 jam berturut-turut, tidak dapat diganti uang atas permintaan pemberi kerja
rules.n: One rest day of at least 24 continuous hours each week.

rules.gi: Hong Kong SAR · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.v: Equal to or longer than for other workers
rules.vi: Sama atau lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
rules.n: Paid annual leave of 7-14 days as for other employees.

rules.gi: Hong Kong SAR · pekerja rumah tangga

rules.gi: Hong Kong SAR · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.v: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required

Standard Employment Contract for Domestic Helpers (ID 407)

decisions.nm: Vallejos v. Commissioner of Registration
decisions.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.pe: A domestic worker from the Philippines had worked in Hong Kong for many years. Most people who live there for seven years can become permanent residents, but the law says time as a foreign domestic helper does not count. The highest court said that rule is allowed.
decisions.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga dari Filipina sudah bekerja di Hong Kong bertahun-tahun. Kebanyakan orang yang tinggal tujuh tahun di sana bisa menjadi penduduk tetap, tetapi hukum menyatakan masa kerja sebagai pekerja rumah tangga asing tidak dihitung. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan aturan itu boleh.

decisions.nm: Lubiano v. Director of Immigration
decisions.ct: Court of Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.pe: A domestic worker challenged the rule that helpers must live with their employers, saying it leads to very long hours. Both courts said the government may keep the rule.
decisions.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga menggugat aturan wajib tinggal bersama majikan, karena aturan itu membuat jam kerja sangat panjang. Kedua pengadilan menyatakan pemerintah boleh mempertahankan aturan itu.

decisions.nm: GA and others v. Director of Immigration
decisions.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.pe: People waiting years for their protection claims in Hong Kong were not allowed to work. The highest court said they have no right to work, though the government may allow it case by case.
decisions.pi: Orang yang bertahun-tahun menunggu permohonan perlindungan di Hong Kong tidak boleh bekerja. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan mereka tidak punya hak bekerja, walau pemerintah boleh mengizinkan kasus per kasus.

decisions.nm: ZN v. Secretary for Justice
decisions.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.pe: A Pakistani man said he was made to work for years in Hong Kong without pay. He argued Hong Kong must have a crime of human trafficking. The highest court disagreed.
decisions.pi: Seorang pria Pakistan mengaku dipaksa bekerja bertahun-tahun di Hong Kong tanpa upah. Ia berargumen Hong Kong wajib punya tindak pidana perdagangan orang. Pengadilan tertinggi tidak setuju.

decisions.nm: HKSAR v. Law Wan-tung (Erwiana Sulistyaningsih case)
decisions.ct: District Court, Hong Kong
decisions.pe: An Indonesian domestic worker was badly beaten by her employer and sent home barely able to walk. Her case caused protests. The court convicted the employer and sent her to prison for six years.
decisions.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga Indonesia dianiaya berat oleh majikannya dan dipulangkan dalam keadaan hampir tak bisa berjalan. Kasusnya memicu protes. Pengadilan memvonis majikan dan memenjarakannya enam tahun.

decisions.nm: HKSAR v. Tai Chi-wai and Catherine Au Yuk-shan (Kartika Puspitasari case)
decisions.ct: District Court, Hong Kong
decisions.pe: An Indonesian domestic worker was abused for two years by her employers. A Hong Kong court convicted both employers and sent them to prison.
decisions.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga Indonesia dianiaya selama dua tahun oleh majikannya. Pengadilan Hong Kong memvonis kedua majikan dan memenjarakan mereka.

decisions.nm: Comilang v. Director of Immigration
decisions.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.pe: Former domestic workers from the Philippines and Indonesia had children who are Hong Kong permanent residents. They asked to stay to raise them. The highest court said they had no right to stay.
decisions.pi: Mantan pekerja rumah tangga dari Filipina dan Indonesia punya anak yang menjadi penduduk tetap Hong Kong. Mereka meminta tinggal untuk membesarkan anak-anak itu. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan mereka tidak berhak tinggal.

decisions.nm: Kong Yunming v. Director of Social Welfare
decisions.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.pe: A woman who moved from mainland China to Hong Kong was refused welfare because she had not lived there seven years. The highest court said this rule was unconstitutional.
decisions.pi: Seorang perempuan yang pindah dari Tiongkok daratan ke Hong Kong ditolak bantuan sosial karena belum tinggal tujuh tahun. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan aturan itu inkonstitusional.

decisions.nm: Fok Chun Wa v. Hospital Authority
decisions.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.pe: Women from mainland China married to Hong Kong men were charged much more to give birth in public hospitals. The highest court let the higher fees stand.
decisions.pi: Perempuan dari Tiongkok daratan yang menikah dengan pria Hong Kong dikenakan biaya persalinan jauh lebih tinggi di rumah sakit umum. Pengadilan tertinggi mempertahankan biaya itu.

decisions.nm: Ghulam Rbani v. Secretary for Justice
decisions.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.pe: A Pakistani man was held for weeks by Hong Kong immigration officers without anyone deciding whether he needed to be held. The top court said that part of his detention was unlawful.
decisions.pi: Seorang pria Pakistan ditahan berminggu-minggu oleh petugas imigrasi Hong Kong tanpa ada yang memutuskan apakah ia perlu ditahan. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan sebagian penahanan itu tidak sah.

decisions.nm: C v. Director of Immigration
decisions.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.pe: Hong Kong had left refugee claims to the UN refugee agency. The top court said the government must judge the risk itself before sending anyone away.
decisions.pi: Hong Kong menyerahkan klaim pengungsi kepada badan pengungsi PBB. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan pemerintah harus menilai sendiri risikonya sebelum mengeluarkan siapa pun.

decisions.nm: Ubamaka v. Secretary for Security
decisions.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.pe: A Nigerian man who had served a prison sentence in Hong Kong feared a second prosecution at home. The top court said the protection against cruel treatment applies to deportation, but not on these facts.
decisions.pi: Seorang pria Nigeria yang telah menjalani hukuman penjara di Hong Kong takut dituntut lagi di negaranya. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan perlindungan dari perlakuan kejam berlaku bagi deportasi, tetapi tidak dalam fakta ini.

decisions.nm: Ng Ka Ling v. Director of Immigration
decisions.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.pe: Thousands of children in mainland China had a parent living in Hong Kong. The top court said they had the right to live in Hong Kong. Months later, an interpretation by China’s legislature limited the effect of the ruling.
decisions.pi: Ribuan anak di Tiongkok daratan punya orang tua yang tinggal di Hong Kong. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan mereka berhak tinggal di Hong Kong. Beberapa bulan kemudian, tafsir badan legislatif Tiongkok membatasi akibat putusan itu.

decisions.nm: Director of Immigration v. Chong Fung Yuen
decisions.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.pe: A boy was born in Hong Kong to parents from mainland China who were visiting. The top court said he had the right to live in Hong Kong because he was born there.
decisions.pi: Seorang anak laki-laki lahir di Hong Kong dari orang tua asal Tiongkok daratan yang sedang berkunjung. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan ia berhak tinggal di Hong Kong karena lahir di sana.

decisions.nm: Lau Kong Yung v. Director of Immigration
decisions.ct: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.pe: Right of abode after the 1999 NPCSC interpretation.
decisions.pi: Hak tinggal setelah tafsir Komite Tetap KRN 1999.

decisions.nm: Fateh Muhammad v. Commissioner of Registration

decisions.pe: Whether time in prison counts as ordinary residence for permanent residence.
decisions.pi: Apakah masa di penjara dihitung sebagai tinggal biasa untuk izin tinggal tetap.

decisions.pe: Right of a non-permanent resident to leave and re-enter during a valid stay.
